intent: The action region at the bottom of a sheet's panel.
typical_uses: The primary action stacked with a Cancel

dont_use_when.situation: The action region of a centered dialog

invariants.text: SheetFooter stacks its children in source order in a column spaced var(--space-2) apart at every viewport width, with a var(--space-4) padding on every side that replaces the panel's var(--space-6) inset for this child, and a `margin-top: auto`, which pushes it to the panel's bottom when the content is shorter than the panel.
SheetFooter is sticky at the bottom of the panel with the panel's own opaque background, so content scrolling under it stays hidden.

good.title: Save with a Cancel that closes the sheet

bad.title: A footer placed outside the panel
bad.why: Only SheetContent is portalled into the panel; a footer beside it renders in the page, visible whether the sheet is open or not.
